purpose: Decompose the ~7x cross-product amplitude gap axis by axis on identical real MGEX station-days: statistic type (saturating phase direction vs linear real coherency), flat-line filter, common-mode removal, and Welch spectral window; plus a labelled Monte-Carlo estimator transfer calibration.

statistics.real_coherency: mean_band Re{Pxy/sqrt(Pxx Pyy)} (linear; Papers 1-2 alt estimator)

paper1_code_finals.spec: nperseg=min(1024,T) single segment, no flat filter, no CM removal

paper2_code_longspan.spec: nperseg=min(1024,T) single segment, no flat filter, no CM removal

estimator_transfer_calibration.note: Monte Carlo on synthetic red-noise pairs; estimator calibration only - not data
